title: Count a Letter
problem: Read a line of text, then on the next line a single letter. Print how many times that letter appears in the text. Upper case and lower case are different letters. For example, the text banana and the letter a gives 3.
starter_code:
# Line 1: a line of text. Line 2: a single letter.
# Print how many times the letter appears in the text.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Look at the letters of the text one at a time and keep a count of the ones that match.
hints.2: Use a loop over the text. Inside it, compare the current character with the letter you were given, and add one to a counter when they are equal. Start the counter at zero.
hints.3:
text = input()
letter = input()
count = 0
for ch in text:
    if ch == letter:
        count += 1
print(count)

failure_explanation: Compare each character with the letter exactly as given: a capital letter and its lower-case form are different, so do not change the case. Start your counter at zero so a letter that never appears gives 0, and print only the final count.
